# ankra_organisations (Data Source)

Lists the organisations the token's user is an active member of. The counterpart of `ankra org list`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_organisations" "all" {}

output "organisation_names" {
  value = [for organisation in data.ankra_organisations.all.organisations : organisation.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the data source.
- `organisations` (Attributes List) Organisations, ordered by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--organisations))

<a id="nestedatt--organisations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `organisations`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Organisation id.
- `name` (String) Organisation name.
- `role` (String) The user's role in it.
- `slug` (String) URL slug.
- `user_current` (Boolean) Whether requests act in this organisation.
